moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening match.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Excitement
angles.copy: Football's back! The Premier League season kicks off this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Coventry's Return
angles.copy: After 25 years, Coventry City are back in the Premier League! They face champions Arsenal on opening night. Big ask!

angles.name: Local Teams in Action
angles.copy: The Premier League returns this weekend! Who will you be supporting, and can we see some Welsh talent shine this season?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival returns from August 27th to 30th, promising a massive bank holiday weekend of music across both sites.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Only 9 days until Reading & Leeds Festival kicks off! Who's heading to Richfield Avenue or Bramham Park for the bank holiday weekend?

angles.name: Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Festival season wraps up for many with Reading & Leeds next weekend. What are your bank holiday plans?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart & Trending
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold strong at Number 1 on the Official Singles Chart, while Madonna & Kylie Minogue enter the Top 10. KATSEYE leads the Official Trending Chart with 'Animal'.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still at Number 1! Who's your favourite on the Official Singles Chart right now?

angles.name: Pop Royalty Team Up
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue together in the Top 10! 'Love Sensation' is giving us all the pop royalty vibes.

angles.name: Trending Tracks
angles.copy: KATSEYE's 'Animal' is dominating the Trending Chart, plus Tame Impala and Steve Lacy are surging thanks to 'Spiderman: Brand New Day'. What's your top trending track?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Anticipation
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 in September, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge alongside Paul Hollywood, Alison Hammond, and Noel Fielding.

angles.name: Bake Off Returns
angles.copy: Get ready, Bake Off is back next month! Nigella Lawson joins the tent as a new judge. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson as a Bake Off judge – what a brilliant addition! We can't wait to see her bring her warmth and wit to the tent.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Pre-Season Buzz
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is building excitement for its September launch with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, Johannes Radebe, and an announced celebrity line-up including Melanie Walters and John Nellis.

angles.name: Strictly Stars Unveiled
angles.copy: The Strictly Come Dancing line-up is officially out! Who are you most excited to see hit the dancefloor this September?

angles.name: Welsh Talent on Strictly
angles.copy: Our very own Melanie Walters from Gavin & Stacey is joining Strictly! We'll be cheering her on every week!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaches
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking a three-day weekend for many and the traditional Notting Hill Carnival in London.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: Who's already planning their August Bank Holiday weekend? Only 13 days to go until that much-needed long weekend!

angles.name: Notting Hill Carnival
angles.copy: London is gearing up for Notting Hill Carnival over the Bank Holiday weekend! Get ready for incredible music, costumes, and culture.

moments.title: Dua Lipa's Birthday
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Dua Lipa turns 31 on August 22nd.

angles.name: Celebrating Dua Lipa
angles.copy: Future Nostalgia Queen Dua Lipa turns 31 this Saturday! What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: Elvis Costello's Birthday
moments.blurb: Influential rock singer-songwriter Elvis Costello turns 72 on August 25th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Elvis Costello
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the legendary Elvis Costello on Tuesday! What's his quintessential track for you?

moments.title: Gene Simmons' Birthday
moments.blurb: Kiss co-founder and bassist Gene Simmons turns 77 on August 25th.

angles.name: Kiss Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Rock icon Gene Simmons of Kiss celebrates his 77th birthday on Tuesday! Shout out your favourite Kiss anthem!

moments.title: Shirley Manson's Birthday
moments.blurb: Garbage frontwoman Shirley Manson turns 60 on August 26th.

angles.name: Celebrating Shirley Manson
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson of Garbage on Wednesday! What's your go-to Garbage track?
